Passage: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) released the updated guidelines for the Social Amelioration Program (SAP) for 2024. The program provides cash assistance to low-income families affected by economic disruptions. Under the new guidelines, beneficiaries must be registered in the Listahanan, the national targeting system for poverty reduction. The cash grant amounts vary based on family size: a family of four receives ₱8,000, while families with more than four members receive an additional ₱1,000 per extra member, up to a maximum of ₱12,000. The DSWD emphasized that only those who meet the criteria and have not received similar assistance from other government programs are eligible.
